doc.title: Bobby Militello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 14, 2002

title: Wrap-up and thanks
summary: Closing remarks, invitations to the Tralf and a Brubeck concert.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well there you go. That’s some great words of wisdom and well this has been really fascinating.
I’ve been pleased to meet you. You’ve got your act together in a number of venues and so I look forward to visiting your club sometime.
Yeah tonight would be a good night.
There’s a lot of good acts down there.
